caveat: Measured in an engineered sucrose-exporting PCC 7942 strain (cscB+ Δsps), not wild type and not UTEX 2973; the deposit has no publication. Endpoints only, by owner decision of 2026-10-07: the intermediate oxygen steps of each campaign are deposited but not shipped. Five condition sets are not shipped at all because GEO and the deposited matrix disagree on which adapted population they came from. The eight pANS plasmid rows (HTX97_RS) have no UTEX counterpart.
